content: Task runners for research data-regeneration chains: Make is the most widely familiar, zero-extra-deps option; 'make check' is a standard convention (run test suite). Quant-paper reproducibility pattern: acceptance test = clone + uv sync + make all, with CI verifying regenerated numbers match published versions. just solves Make syntax pain (tabs/.PHONY) but adds a tool dependency; npm scripts lack an endorsed canonical entry point and hit cross-platform issues. Make timestamp-based re-runs are also its determinism liability; content-hash tools (Snakemake/DVC) are stronger but overkill here.
